This professional is responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing software for embedded systems, ensuring that performance, security, real-time, and resource utilization requirements are rigorously met. Through their work, the Embedded Software Engineer contributes significantly to the performance and reliability of our systems, ensuring the success of our products in the market.

jobTitle: SW Engineer L3 - Technical Product Owner
mission: The mission of the Software Technical Product Owner is to act as the strategic bridge between business needs, product vision, and the software development team, ensuring that the delivered technical solutions maximize customer value and align with organizational objectives. This professional is responsible for defining, communicating, and prioritizing the product backlog based on a deep technical and market understanding, translating complex requirements into clear user stories and technical specifications. Through their leadership and collaboration, the Technical Product Owner drives the effectiveness of the software development process, ensures its technical feasibility and scalability, and guarantees the continuous delivery of high-quality products.
